routines.contract: ordered argv + enum-order links + name/jumps + white file + DM-series + nofit/fit + simulate/set + stage1 + epoch + forbidden fits + DM file + T2/TN/TOBS + modify + stage2 + plugin/select + stage3, then global PAR
routines.name: preProcess

routines.contract: nonempty bounded file, feof repeats last stored line unless tokenized; exact PASS/REJECT/PROCESS, insensitive LOGIC; mutations across all pulsars
routines.name: useSelectFile

routines.contract: five assigned tokens; EXIST can use four but fixtures supply five; numeric threshold must parse when comparison consumes it; first matching undeleted flag
routines.name: logicFlag

routines.contract: six assigned tokens; independent sequential mode tests on undeleted matching flag rows
routines.name: processFlag

routines.contract: six/seven valid tokens or early return; strict threshold; nested i/j mutation; carried found flags in only mode
routines.name: processSimultaneous

routines.contract: bounded complete raw tokens; JITTER then START_TIME_JITTER/TOAERR_ZERO in file order; all rows including deleted
routines.name: readWhiteNoiseModelFile

routines.contract: one initialized pulsar; stage1(0,-1), stage2(0,0,null,0), stage3; no wrapper ndm read
routines.name: preProcessSimple

routines.contract: nWhite used by both scans; sentinel -1; EPHVER overrides tempo1; final stored observation for last; units100 active
routines.name: preProcessSimple1

routines.contract: weighted zero-error exit before row writes; vector/phase/offset/filter/pass/jumps/FD/-to/DM order; append counts
routines.name: preProcessSimple2

routines.contract: FJUMP discovery undeleted/id-aware then value-only application including deleted; ordinary then FD; phase ID assignment -1 and double search from index1
routines.name: preProcessSimple3

routines.contract: valid index; val/err/prefit/prefitErr in order regardless of flags
routines.name: scale_param

routines.contract: valid index; binary64 IFTE_MJD0 promoted; prefit[0] input even for arr>0
routines.name: xform_mjd

routines.contract: from/to integer tests; sequential repeated factors, DM/CM loops, BPJ index0 before later elements; exact @ TZR gate; units retained
routines.name: transform_units

routines.contract: psr[0] selection controls, psr[p] rows; SAT/BAT boundary flags1/2; sentinel -1 and bounded int narrowing; numeric-prefix parser
routines.name: updateEpoch_str

routines.contract: dt to double; F0/F1/F2 and conditional F3 sequence, selected prefit, RA then DEC then RA2 then DEC2, DM0; FITWAVES diagnostics; binary block inactive
routines.name: updateEpoch

unrun.reason: ndm uninitialized argument value; simple2 short circuit does not define caller read
unchecked fopen/feof; empty file reads unwritten line; >10000 rows unchecked
tobsval unwritten if no matching flag; invalid atof becomes defined zero but is not metadata default
first failed fgets leaves line unwritten
missing argv/value/select/noise tokens, malformed numeric comparison, dangling tOffset flag or pass value before ID can consume unwritten/null data
unchecked jump/FD append, invalid counts, flag strings >15 for FJUMP, unsafe output capacity; bounded last-valid capacity exits allowed
nonfinite/out-of-int-range DM index, epoch selection or NITS conversion
dlsym failure followed by dlclose then dlerror; diagnostic pointer lifetime/null behavior host-dependent, withheld
dlerror cleared in loop then printf %s with null; no portable result, withheld
global reader elong/elat scratch uninitialized; fixtures use only fully assigned scalar/common records
not forced; separate environmental/resource failure coverage
